status: Requirements and logical data design; application not implemented or runtime-tested

tables.name: users
tables.rules: Parol xeshi framework orqali; ochiq parol saqlanmaydi. Tahrir updated_at server vaqti bilan.

tables.name: user_contacts
tables.rules: WhatsApp va SMS bir PHONE kontaktining yetkazish kanali. Revoked kontakt qayta berilishi faqat tekshirilgan recovery bilan; avtomatik account merge yo‘q.

tables.name: auth_challenges
tables.rules: Kontakt hali mavjud bo‘lmasa digest ishlaydi; raw manzil faqat qisqa muddatli shifrlangan delivery payload. Har consume atomar va bir martalik.

tables.name: sessions
tables.rules: Cookie HttpOnly/Secure; yangi qurilmada PHONE-only eski ma’lumotni ochmaydi. Revoke barcha sezgir so‘rovlarda tekshiriladi.

tables.name: mfa_credentials
tables.rules: TOTP siri kalit boshqaruvi bilan shifrlanadi. Passkey private key serverda bo‘lmaydi; recovery kodlar alohida xeshlangan qiymatlar.

tables.name: recovery_requests
tables.purpose: Kontakt, dublikat va oxirgi egani tiklash
tables.rules: Reviewer requester bo‘la olmaydi. Account merge FKlarni auditlangan migratsiya bilan ko‘chiradi; uchinchi tomon huquqlarini qo‘shib yubormaydi.

tables.name: platform_role_grants
tables.rules: Faqat PLATFORM role; grantor o‘ziga grant bera olmaydi. Sezgir grant ikki mustaqil tasdiq va audit bilan.

tables.name: consent_events
tables.rules: Append-only. Marketing opt-in alohida; xizmat uchun zarur ishlovga majburiy marketing ulanmaydi.

tables.name: candidate_profiles
tables.purpose: Talaba bo‘lmagan va talaba nomzodning umumiy profili
tables.rules: Talabalik bu jadvalning majburiy ustuni emas. CV faqat nomzod va arizasi bo‘yicha ruxsatli HRga; global ochiq eksport yo‘q.

tables.name: candidate_skills
tables.rules: Self-declared va tasdiqlangan malaka farqlanadi; case APPROVED bo‘lmasa verified ko‘rinmaydi.

tables.name: enrollments
checks: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date
tables.rules: Tarix saqlanadi. Bir nechta ta’lim bo‘lishi mumkin; biriktirish aniq enrollmentga. Tasdiq muddati bitganda umumiy ish huquqi qoladi.

tables.name: availability_rules
checks: start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND start_minute < end_minute
valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from
tables.rules: Oraliqlar [start,end). Kesishgan mavjudlik union qilinadi, daqiqalar ikki marta sanalmaydi.

tables.name: availability_exceptions
checks: start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND start_minute < end_minute

tables.name: files
tables.rules: Baza fayl tanasini saqlamaydi. Karantin, MIME/magic tekshiruvi, hajm limiti, qisqa signed URL va yuklash huquqi shart. Maxfiylikni key nomi bilan hal qilib bo‘lmaydi.

tables.name: verification_cases
tables.purpose: Shaxs, tashkilot yoki ta’limni tekshirish navbati
tables.rules: Har tur uchun haqiqiy FK, target_type/target_id jufti yo‘q. Tekshiruvchi o‘z murojaatini tasdiqlamaydi.

tables.name: verification_evidence
checks: file_id IS NOT NULL OR note IS NOT NULL

tables.name: organizations
tables.rules: Mavjud STIR yangi tashkilot yaratmaydi. Birinchi vakil mustaqil tekshiruvdan so‘ng; public ma’lumot va maxfiy dalil ajratiladi.

tables.name: organization_capabilities
tables.rules: Tasdiqlangan capability ham faol a’zo rolini almashtirmaydi.

tables.name: org_memberships
tables.rules: Ownerdan boshqa a’zolik pul va egalik huquqini avtomatik bermaydi. Oxirgi active owner tranzaksiyada himoyalanadi.

tables.name: org_role_grants
tables.rules: Faqat ORG role. Ruxsat aktif membership, role va assignment kesishmasi; global union emas.

tables.name: org_invitations
tables.rules: 24 soat; inviter ayni orgga mansub; kontakt va qabul qiluvchi mos; repeat accept idempotent.

tables.name: org_ownership_events
tables.purpose: Birinchi va keyingi egani tayinlash dalili
tables.rules: Grant mustaqil reviewer bilan; oxirgi egani yo‘qotishdan oldin o‘rinbosar yoki recovery. Append-only.

tables.name: institution_agreements
checks: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from
tables.rules: Rasmiy baho, imzo, eksport va ishlov asosi kelishuvga bog‘liq; umumiy platforma PDFsi imzo deb taqdim etilmaydi.

tables.name: institution_role_grants
tables.rules: Faqat INSTITUTION role va ayni muassasaning faol rasmiy appointmenti bilan.

tables.name: institution_appointments
checks: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from
tables.rules: Email domeni o‘zi tayinlov emas. Tayinlangan shaxs taklifni qabul qiladi, moderator o‘zini tayinlamaydi.

tables.name: student_supervisions
tables.rules: Uch yozuvning institution_id qiymati teng. O‘quvchi boshqa muassasaga o‘tsa eski scope ko‘chmaydi; mas’ulga berilgan maqsad bilangina ko‘rinadi.

tables.name: opportunities
tables.rules: Counter va offer qabuli bir tranzaksiya/lockda. Active occupied applications bilan kunlik reconciliation; counter mustaqil tahrirlanmaydi.

tables.name: opportunity_revisions
checks: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date
salary_max IS NULL OR salary_max >= salary_min
tables.rules: PART_TIME va pullik INTERNSHIP uchun salary_min/max, UZS, davr/brutto-netto; INTERNSHIP end majburiy; unpaidda salary null. Bu cross-table qoidalar publish tranzaksiyasi va acceptance test bilan. Nashrdagi qator update qilinmaydi.

tables.name: opportunity_shifts
checks: start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND start_minute < end_minute
tables.rules: Tungi smena ikki sana/hafta kuniga bo‘linadi; barcha intervallar yarim ochiq.

tables.name: opportunity_hr_assignments
tables.rules: E’lon va membership tashkiloti teng, HR roli aktiv. Organization owner ham ko‘rish amalida shu maqsad va audit talabiga bo‘ysunadi.

tables.name: applications
tables.purpose: Bitta nomzod va bitta e’lon munosabati
tables.rules: Retry yangi application yaratmaydi. Version conditional update, transition va capacity bir tranzaksiyada.

tables.name: application_attempts
tables.purpose: Qayta ariza va o‘sha paytdagi shartlar
tables.rules: Revision ayni e’longa, enrollment ayni candidatega tegishli. Snapshot schema-valid va minimallashtirilgan; keyinchalik CV o‘zgarishi tarixni buzmaydi.

tables.name: application_events
tables.rules: Append-only. REJECTED/EXPIREDdan qayta ochish HR ruxsati bilan; 24h va 3/30kun limit service tranzaksiyasida.

tables.name: interviews
tables.rules: Tashkilot doirasi tekshiriladi; o‘zgarishlar audit/eventga. MVP platformadagi tasdiq, tashqi calendar sync emas.

tables.name: offers
tables.rules: Bir applicationda bir ACTIVE offer uchun partial unique index. OFFERED joyni kafolatlamaydi; ACCEPT atomar capacity tekshiradi; expires_at serverda ham tekshiriladi.

tables.name: job_engagements
checks: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date
tables.rules: Faqat PART_TIME. Ikki tomon STARTni tasdiqlamaguncha haqiqiy ishga joylashish statistikasi emas; kundalik avtomatik ochilmaydi.

tables.name: engagement_confirmations
tables.rules: Nomzod o‘zi yoki berilgan vakolatli HR; side foydalanuvchi tanlagan erkin satrga ishonib berilmaydi.

tables.name: placements
checks: NOT academic_track OR enrollment_id IS NOT NULL
tables.rules: Faqat INTERNSHIP. Nomzod/application/offer/host bir-biriga mos. Academic ACTIVEda faol agreement, supervisor va mentor qabuli kerak.

tables.name: mentor_assignments
tables.rules: Faqat host orgidagi faol MENTOR. Self-review yo‘q; bir vaqtda bitta asosiy accepted mentor partial unique bilan.

tables.name: academic_assignments
tables.rules: Teacher muassasasi enrollment va supervisionga mos. Bir vaqtda bitta asosiy accepted teacher. O‘z kundaligini boshqa rol bilan ko‘rish/tasdiqlash rad.

tables.name: placement_decisions
tables.rules: Tegishli tomon vakolati va reja versiyasi tekshiriladi; completion shartlari yopilmaguncha COMPLETED emas.

tables.name: daily_logs
tables.purpose: Placement va mahalliy sana uchun bitta kun

tables.name: log_revisions
tables.rules: total_minutes faqat task_entries SUMidan serverda; SUBMITTED immutable. Sana, placement, kechikish, overlap, reja chegaralari topshirish tranzaksiyasida.

tables.name: log_task_entries
checks: (start_minute IS NULL AND end_minute IS NULL) OR (start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND end_minute > start_minute AND minutes = end_minute - start_minute)
tables.rules: plan_task ayni placement rejasidan. Oraliq berilgan ishlar kesishmaydi; daqiqa-only yozuvga soxta aniq overlap da’vosi qilinmaydi.

tables.name: log_evidence
tables.rules: Muallif yuklash huquqi, clean scan va host confidentiality; ko‘ruvchi assignmenti tekshiriladi.

tables.name: workplace_log_reviews
tables.rules: APPROVED/RETURNED; faqat qabul qilingan faol assignment. Muallifga o‘zini tasdiqlash taqiqlangan; oldingi qaror yangi revisionni tasdiqlamaydi.

tables.name: academic_log_reviews
tables.rules: REVIEWED/NEEDS_REVISION, workplace approval o‘rnini bosa olmaydi.

tables.name: log_amendment_requests
tables.rules: Mustaqil review va audit; texnik uzilish sababli avtomatik jazo yo‘q.

tables.name: rubric_versions
tables.rules: Workplace/academic/employer/mentor oilalari ajratiladi. Formula o‘zgarsa yangi immutable version.

tables.name: rubric_criteria
tables.rules: ACTIVE qilishda required mezonlar yig‘indisi 100 va to‘liqlik tekshiriladi.

tables.name: rating_submissions
checks: target_user_id IS NULL OR target_user_id <> rater_id
tables.rules: Bir rater/relation/rubric uchun bitta final; partial unique indexes. Haqiqiy completed ishtirok, target va rubrika doirasi service tekshiradi. Rating feature flag boshlang‘ich OFF.

tables.name: rating_revisions
tables.purpose: Bahoning o‘zgarmas matn va formula nusxasi
tables.rules: Submitted revision update qilinmaydi; tuzatish yangi revision, eski ball va e’tiroz dalili saqlanadi.

tables.name: rating_scores
tables.rules: Criterion submissionning ayni rubricidan; score min/max ichida. Akademik va workplace bir songa aralashmaydi.

tables.name: rating_appeals
tables.rules: 14kun murojaat, 5ishkun nishon; nizoli baho vaqtincha aggregate tashqarisida. Reviewer munosabat ishtirokchisi emas.

tables.name: rating_aggregates
tables.rules: Haqiqat manbai submission, bu kesh. n<5da score public emas; unrated 0 emas. Bir relation bir ovoz; appeals bilan qayta hisob. Partial unique target/rubric/window.

tables.name: products
tables.rules: Candidate search free. POST_30D va ORG_PLAN_30D pilot narxlari; amaliyot/akademik xizmat shartnoma bo‘lmasa pullik va’da qilinmaydi.

tables.name: price_versions
checks: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

tables.name: orders
tables.rules: Org billing vakolati; order e’loni ayni orgga. Stavka keyin o‘zgarsa eski order o‘zgarmaydi.

tables.name: invoices
tables.rules: Fiskal talab operatorning huquqiy shakliga mos mutaxassis bilan; oddiy PDFni fiskal chek deb atamaslik.

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.rules: Bir order ko‘p attempt; muvaffaqiyat entitlementsni bir marta beradi. Callback protokoli provayderga mos; brauzer success pul tasdig‘i emas.

tables.name: payment_events
tables.rules: Server auth/protokol, amount/order/currency mosligi. Kartaning maxfiy rekvizitlari saqlanmaydi; payload PII minimallashtirilgan.

tables.name: service_entitlements
checks: ends_at IS NULL OR starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at
tables.rules: POST_30D muddati publishdan, pul tushgan kundan emas. Org plan birinchi publish yoki aniq aktivatsiyadan boshlanadi; auto-renew MVPda OFF. Bepul pilot grant auditlanadi.

tables.name: refunds
checks: approver_id IS NULL OR approver_id <> requester_id
tables.rules: Yig‘indi muvaffaqiyatli refunds captured summadan oshmaydi; lock + callback idempotency. Katta summaga ikkinchi mustaqil tasdiq audit_eventda.

tables.name: billing_ledger
tables.rules: Capture/refund/credit manbasi ko‘rsatiladi; balans tahrirlanmaydi. Reconciliation bank/provider natijasiga; bu nomzod ish haqi yoki escrow hamyoni emas.

tables.name: moderation_cases
tables.purpose: E’lon, tashkilot, fayl yoki bahoga shikoyat
tables.rules: Target FK bilan. Avtomatik signal navbat yaratadi; sudsiz qora ro‘yxat yoki pulga yashirish yo‘q. Scam bo‘lsa vaqtli hide va mustaqil review.

tables.name: moderation_actions
tables.rules: Append-only; apellyatsiyani dastlabki qaror egasi yakka hal qilmaydi. E’lon yashirilsa accepted munosabat/o‘z dalili yo‘qolmaydi.

tables.name: support_tickets
tables.rules: Ruxsatli yordam xodimi zarur qismni ko‘radi; parol/OTP so‘ramaydi.

tables.name: support_messages
tables.rules: Internal note foydalanuvchi eksportiga chiqmaydi; ilova ayni ticketga ruxsat bilan.

tables.name: privacy_requests
tables.rules: Eksport qayta auth, qisqa TTL link. O‘chirish moliya/legal hold bilan retention siyosatiga muvofiq; muddat huquqiy tasdiqdan so‘ng.

tables.name: retention_policies
tables.rules: Taklif va qonuniy muddat ajratiladi; NULL muddatsiz saqlash ruxsati emas, qaror kutilmoqda. Legal approval bo‘lmagan toifa pilotda yig‘ilmaydi.

tables.name: legal_holds
tables.rules: Vakolatli asos va aniq muddat; barcha hisobni cheksiz saqlash uchun bahona emas.

tables.name: notification_preferences
tables.rules: Marketing opt-in; zarur statuslar sayt ichida qoladi. External kanal tanloviga hurmat qilinadi.

tables.name: outbox_events
tables.rules: Append-only biznes hodisa; payload PII emas yoki minimal opaque ID. Consumer eng kamida bir marta kelishiga chidamli; aggregate_key audit/routing uchun, domain FK o‘rniga emas.

tables.name: notifications
tables.rules: Havola ochilganda joriy huquq qayta tekshiriladi; xabarda maxfiy CV/log matni yo‘q.

tables.name: notification_deliveries
tables.rules: Provider timeout retry backoff+jitter va xarajat limiti; callback foydalanuvchi tasdiqi emas. SMS/WhatsApp delivery OTP consume qilmaydi.

tables.name: audit_events
tables.rules: Object nomi tarixiy audit identifikatori, aktiv domain FK emas. Sir/OTP/raw CV yo‘q; DB roli update/delete qilolmaydi, tashqi immutable nusxa. Aktyor pseudonymi tarixni saqlaydi.

tables.name: idempotency_keys
tables.purpose: Sezgir HTTP amallarining bir marta natijasi
tables.rules: Body digest boshqa bo‘lsa409. Token ownership, operation va scope bilan. Biznes UNIQUE constraintlar TTLdan keyin ham takror moliya yaratishni to‘sadi.

tables.name: analytics_events
tables.rules: Kontakt/log/CV yo‘q; rozilik asosli statistika. Ish boshlash faqat 2tomon tasdiq hodisasi, raw click bilan teng emas.

tables.name: feature_flags
tables.rules: Default OFF: ratings, academic_official_export, WhatsApp, paid_checkout. Flag ruxsatni chetlab o‘tmaydi; o‘zgarish auditlanadi.

tables.name: incidents
tables.rules: 24/7 yordam va’dasi faqat amaldagi navbatchi bilan; hozir P1 on-call tashkil etilishi reliz sharti.

tables.name: restore_runs
tables.rules: Backup fayli borligi restore testi emas. Billing yoqilishidan oldin PITR/ledger reconciliation dalili.

capabilities.name: E’lon qidirish
capabilities.rule: Qidiruvda shaxsiy profil/kundalik yo‘q; muddati o‘tganlar darhol chiqariladi.

capabilities.name: Hisob va kirish
capabilities.rule: Kontakt tasdig‘i rol bermaydi; yangi qurilma va qayta berilgan raqam himoyasi.

capabilities.name: Profil va CV
capabilities.rule: 18+; talabalik umumiy arizaga majburiy emas; fayl clean bo‘lishi kerak.

capabilities.name: Ta’lim tarixi va tasdiq
capabilities.rule: Bitirish umumiy ish huquqini yo‘qotmaydi; APPROVED enrollmentgina student talabini qoplaydi.

capabilities.name: Bo‘sh vaqt va istisno
capabilities.rule: 28kun, yarim ochiq intervallar, 30min commute; UNKNOWN alohida.

capabilities.name: E’lon saqlash
capabilities.rule: Unique candidate/opportunity; yopilganini arxiv belgisi bilan ko‘rsatish.

capabilities.name: Ariza va qayta ariza
capabilities.rule: E’lon eligibilitysi; STRICT jadval to‘sig‘i; snapshot, 24h va 3/30kun qayta urinish.

capabilities.name: Nomzodni ko‘rish va saralash
capabilities.rule: Faol org va rol; HOST_COORDINATOR faqat INTERNSHIP, HR/owner tegishli e’lon assignmenti. Global CV bazasi yo‘q.

capabilities.name: Suhbat belgilash/javob
capabilities.rule: Vaqt o‘zgarishi ikkala tomonga; tashqi kalendar sync MVP emas.

capabilities.name: Taklif yaratish/bekor qilish
capabilities.rule: HR/host tegishli kind va assignment; terms snapshot, TTL; yuborish joyni band qilmaydi.

capabilities.name: Taklif qabul qilish
capabilities.rule: Row lock capacity; bir o‘rin uchun ikki parallel acceptdan biri409; expiry va version tekshiriladi.

capabilities.name: Ish boshlandi/yakun/nizo
capabilities.scope: O‘z ish munosabati yoki HR scope
capabilities.rule: 2tomon STARTdan keyin ACTIVE; bir tomon da’vosi avtomatik salbiy reyting emas.

capabilities.name: Tashkilot va birinchi vakil
capabilities.rule: STIR unique, mustaqil reviewer; hujjat yuborish vakolat tasdig‘i emas.

capabilities.name: Xodim taklif va rol bekori
capabilities.rule: 24h taklif, explicit roles; oxirgi owner himoyasi; revoked scope darhol yopiladi.

capabilities.name: Xodim taklifini qabul
capabilities.rule: GET token bo‘yicha minimal taklif; POST uchun login, verified target kontakt va TTL. Yangi odamdan hali olmagan rol talab qilinmaydi; assignment alohida qabul.

capabilities.name: E’lon yaratish/nashr/tahrir
capabilities.rule: PART_TIME uchun maosh; INTERNSHIP end/is_paid; material tahrir yangi revision va moderation.

capabilities.name: Amaliyot reja va mentor
capabilities.rule: Mentor active membership va shaxsiy accept; normal job kundalik talab qilmaydi.

capabilities.name: Amaliyot shartlari va assignment qabuli
capabilities.rule: O‘z roli shartini qabul qiladi; boshqa tomon nomidan accept yo‘q.

capabilities.name: Rasmiy muassasa va tayinlov
capabilities.rule: Platforma tekshiradi; domen yetarli emas; academic agreement va legal basis kerak.

capabilities.name: Talaba va o‘qituvchi biriktirish
capabilities.rule: Enrollment, agreement, appointment muassasasi teng; teacher self-assignment yo‘q.

capabilities.name: Akademik jarayonni kuzatish
capabilities.scope: Koordinator purpose yoki qabul qilingan teacher assignment
capabilities.rule: Boshqa talaba/ish arizasi va maosh bazasi ochilmaydi; revoked scope old sessiyada ham yopiq.

capabilities.name: Amaliyot kundaligi va dalil
capabilities.rule: Sana/reja/sum/overlap, 7kun, immutable submitted revision, conflict412 va idempotency.

capabilities.name: Ish joyi kundaligini tasdiqlash
capabilities.rule: O‘z yozuvini tasdiqlash yo‘q. Eski revision approval yangisini yopmaydi; 3ishkun eskalatsiya.

capabilities.name: Akademik fikr va yakun
capabilities.rule: Workplace approval o‘rnini bosmaydi; rasmiy baho/imzo alohida kelishuvga.

capabilities.name: Amaliyot yakuni/chiqish
capabilities.rule: Reja/soat, returned yozuvlar va tegishli ikki review yopiladi; sana o‘zi COMPLETED qilmaydi.

capabilities.name: Amaliyot hisobotini olish
capabilities.scope: O‘ziga ruxsatli placement va minimal data
capabilities.rule: Qayta auth va short-lived link; axborot PDFsi, rasmiy imzo emas.

capabilities.name: Munosabatdan keyin baho
capabilities.rule: Self-rating yo‘q, rubric va scope mos; blind14kun, default OFF.

capabilities.name: Bahoga e’tiroz va agregat
capabilities.rule: 14kun murojaat; n<5 public score yo‘q; MVP searchda ishlatilmaydi.

capabilities.name: Tarif, order va hisob
capabilities.rule: Nomzod bepul; narx snapshot; post muddati nashrdan; callback verifieddan keyin aktivatsiya.

capabilities.name: Pul qaytarish va reconciliation
capabilities.scope: O‘z buyurtmasi yoki navbatdagi moliya case
capabilities.rule: So‘rovchi o‘zini tasdiqlamaydi; capture limit va idempotency; rol to‘liq CVni ochmaydi.

capabilities.name: Xabar va kanal sozlash
capabilities.rule: Opt-in marketing, private matn tashqi kanalga yo‘q; revoke keyin havola qayta scope tekshiradi.

capabilities.name: Shikoyat va apellyatsiya
capabilities.scope: Ko‘rilgan public yoki o‘z munosabat targeti
capabilities.rule: Yordamga dalil, retaliation himoyasi; avtomatik qora ro‘yxat yo‘q.

capabilities.name: Tekshirish/moderatsiya
capabilities.rule: Own case review rad; pulga reyting yashirilmaydi; barcha qaror audit.

capabilities.name: Yordam murojaati
capabilities.scope: O‘z ticketi yoki ajratilgan SUPPORT operator
capabilities.rule: Har authenticated odam own-ticket ochadi; operator queue faqat SUPPORT. Internal note foydalanuvchiga chiqmaydi; OTP/parol so‘ralmaydi.

capabilities.name: Rozilik, eksport, tuzatish/o‘chirish
capabilities.scope: O‘z data subject so‘rovi yoki maxsus vakolatli SUPPORT operator
capabilities.rule: Huquqiy retention va legal hold; eksportsiz boshqalar data; backup expiry va redelete manifest. Own request huquqi operator resolve bermaydi.

capabilities.name: Audit va vaqtli admin kirish
capabilities.rule: Biznes rolini o‘ziga berish yo‘q; break-glass reason, expiry, ikkinchi ko‘ruvchi.

capabilities.name: Flag, incident, backup va o‘lchov
capabilities.rule: Target SLO faqat o‘lchanganda qabul; billing PITR/reconciliation shart. Texnik rol pul approval bermaydi.

capabilities.name: Moliyaviy hisobot
capabilities.scope: O‘z orgi yoki platforma moliya agregati
capabilities.rule: FINANCE texnik flag yoki biznes CVni ochmaydi; cash va xizmat majburiyati ajratiladi.

capabilities.name: Ochiq xizmat va siyosat ma’lumoti
capabilities.scope: Faqat public katalog va versiyali siyosat matni
capabilities.rule: Public javobda boshqa odam roziligi yoki yopiq flag konfiguratsiyasi yo‘q; siyosat matni versiyali faylda, consent_events faqat qabulda yoziladi.

capabilities.name: Korxonaning ochiq reytingi
capabilities.rule: Flag OFF yoki n<5 bo‘lsa score qaytmaydi; individual akademik baho ommaga yo‘q.

sections.name: Qidiruv va xizmatlar
sections.behavior: Public xizmat kartalari va qidiruv boshlash

sections.name: Hisob ochish yo‘li
sections.behavior: Nomzod, ish beruvchi, host va rasmiy xodim yo‘llari

sections.name: Filtr va natijalar
sections.behavior: UZ/RU, hudud, kind, salary, skill, schedule; stable cursor

sections.name: Shartlar va tashkilot
sections.behavior: Public immutable published revision, maosh, eligibility va vacancy

sections.name: Munosabatlar bahosi
sections.behavior: Flag OFFda ko‘rsatilmaydi; n<5 score yo‘q

sections.name: Bepul nomzod xizmatlari
sections.behavior: Kimga, qanday shart, real xizmat chegarasi

sections.name: Korxona tariflari
sections.behavior: Taklif narxi, 30kun, aktivatsiya va refund qoidasi

sections.name: Qo‘llanma va tezkor savollar
sections.behavior: Faqat ma’lumot mazmuni; CMS matni alohida versiyalanadi

sections.name: Shartlar/maxfiylik/reyting siyosati
sections.behavior: Ochiq hujjat versiyasi, amal sanasi va aloqa

sections.name: Yo‘l va 18+ tanlovi
sections.behavior: Bitta user, deklaratsiya va shart versiyasi

sections.name: Kontakt va kanal tanlovi
sections.behavior: Email yoki PHONE WhatsApp/SMS; enumeration himoyasi

sections.name: Muassasa xizmat havolasi
sections.behavior: Tayinlov hujjati va keyingi tekshiruv izohi

sections.name: Email/parol yoki telefon kodi
sections.behavior: Rate limit, generic failure va sessiya

sections.name: Qo‘shimcha omil
sections.behavior: Sezgir rol TOTP/passkey; telefon kodi ikki omil emas

sections.name: Qayta yuborish/kanal almashtirish

acceptance.title: Talaba bo‘lmagan nomzod
acceptance.test: 18+ nonstudent profil ochadi va ALL_CANDIDATES ishga talabalik dalilisiz ariza beradi; student-only alohida422.

acceptance.title: Qayta berilgan raqam
acceptance.test: Yangi qurilmadagi telefon OTP eski hisobning CV/kundaligini ochmaydi; eski ishonchli omil yoki recovery kerak.

acceptance.title: Tekshiruv navbati va SLA
acceptance.test: 1/2/3ishkun due va reviewer bor; muddat oshishi tasdiq emas, eskalatsiya.

acceptance.title: Birinchi va oxirgi egasi
acceptance.test: Birinchi egani boshqa reviewer tekshiradi; ikki parallel revoke oxirgi ownerni yo‘qotmaydi.

acceptance.title: Dublikat hisob va kanal xatosi
acceptance.test: Kontakt collision avtomatik merge emas; SMS uzilishida user tanlagan email/WhatsApp yo‘li, eski kod invalid.

acceptance.title: Profil va ta’lim tarixi
acceptance.test: Bitirgan/almashtirgan enrollment tarixi saqlanadi, umumiy profil va arizalar qoladi.

acceptance.title: FK, UNIQUE va scope
acceptance.test: Orphan FK DBda rad; boshqa org/muassasa IDsi read/list/create/exportda403/404; oddiy entitylarda polymorphic target yo‘q.

acceptance.title: Immutable shartlar
acceptance.test: Maosh/jadval keyin o‘zgarsa oldingi attempt va qabul sharti bir xil qoladi; nashrdagi revision update rad.

acceptance.title: Hisob, attempt, refund
acceptance.test: Takror/out-of-order callback bitta capture/huquq; jami refund captured summadan oshmaydi.

acceptance.title: Qayta ariza va kundalik entry
acceptance.test: Bir applicationda ko‘p attempt; kunlik total entry summasi; retry application/logni ko‘paytirmaydi.

acceptance.title: Katalog va eligibility
acceptance.test: Paid part-time, umumiy internship, academic track va nonstudent chegaralari UI/APIga mos.

acceptance.title: O‘rin bandligi
acceptance.test: Bir qolgan o‘ringa ikki parallel ACCEPT: biri200, biri409, occupied_count=capacity.

acceptance.title: Muddatsiz ish va kelishiladigan vaqt
acceptance.test: PART_TIME end_date NULL mumkin; NEGOTIABLE arizada konflikt ochiq, STRICT blok, UNKNOWN alohida.

acceptance.title: Ish boshlanishi va yakuni
acceptance.test: OFFER ACCEPT darhol employed_countni oshirmaydi; ikki tomon START tasdig‘idan keyin ACTIVE.

acceptance.title: Nashr muddati/refund/kredit
acceptance.test: POST30kun publishdan boshlanadi; rad etilgan unused order refund yo‘li; takror kompensatsiya yo‘q.

acceptance.title: Oddiy ish kundaligi chegarasi
acceptance.test: PART_TIME nomzodga diary topshirish majburiyati yo‘q; /logs orqali jobengagementga kundalik ochilmaydi.

acceptance.title: Sana, jami va kesishma
acceptance.test: Kelajak/enddan tashqari sana rad; ikki timed entry kesishmasi rad; daqiqa-onlyga noaniqlik izohi.

acceptance.title: Reja, dalil va sir
acceptance.test: Vazifa ayni reja/placementdan; karantin fayl ko‘rinmaydi; mijoz siri majburiy emas; signed access scope.

acceptance.title: Review va yangi revision
acceptance.test: Mentor3ishkun reminder; teacher separate; old revision approval yangi tahrirni avtomatik tasdiqlamaydi.

acceptance.title: Qoralama, offline va yakun
acceptance.test: Logout private draftni tozalaydi; stale version412; reja/soat/returned yopilmasa COMPLETED rad.

acceptance.title: Formula va versiya
acceptance.test: Weights100, to‘liq required scores; schema/rubric revision o‘zgarmas; academic/workplace ajratiladi.

acceptance.title: Kim baholashi va antifraud
acceptance.test: Faqat completed relation ishtirokchisi; self-rating va bir relation/rater/rubric dublikat rad.

acceptance.title: Kam baho va unrated
acceptance.test: n<5 score public emas; yangi user0 emas; n, vaqt va versiya ko‘rinadi; bir munosabat bir ovoz.

acceptance.title: Ikki tomon fikri va retaliation
acceptance.test: Blind ikkala submission yoki14kun; private academy assessment public emas; haqorat/PII review.

acceptance.title: E’tiroz va search ta’siri
acceptance.test: 14kun appeal, independent review; nizoli ovoz/n qayta hisoblanadi; MVP search rating ishlatmaydi.

acceptance.title: Email/WhatsApp/SMS
acceptance.test: VERIFY_CONTACT kodi LOGIN yoki RECOVERYga o‘tmaydi; 5min/5urinish/60s, replay va resend testi.

acceptance.title: Rol va appointment qabuli
acceptance.test: Yangi odam olmagan rolini oldindan talab qilmasdan tokenni o‘z verified kontaktida qabul qiladi; appointment o‘zi student scope bermaydi.

acceptance.title: Scope bekori va self-review
acceptance.test: Revoked membership eski sessiyada ham ishlamaydi; list/export/jobs bir xil guard; self-review403.

acceptance.title: Fayl va private kesh
acceptance.test: MIME/magic/size/scan; signed URL current authorization; private javob no-store, shared cacheda yo‘q.

acceptance.title: Outbox va xarajat
acceptance.test: DB commitdan keyin crash/retry bir inbox va cheklangan delivery; private matn tashqariga chiqmaydi.

acceptance.title: Scam, moderation va appeal
acceptance.test: Jiddiy flag vaqtli hide; inson qarori/sabab; appeal boshqa reviewer, existing relation dalili saqlanadi.

acceptance.title: Support va incident
acceptance.test: Business-hours due, P1 navbatchi dalili; internal note mijozga chiqmaydi; parol/OTP so‘ralmaydi.

acceptance.title: Retention va restore-delete
acceptance.test: Eksport boshqa odam data bermaydi; delete manifest backup restoreda qayta qo‘llanadi, legal hold aniq muddatli.

acceptance.title: Backup va pul tiklash
acceptance.test: Real izolyatsiyalangan restoreda RPO/RTO o‘lchanadi; provider orqali oxirgi capture/refund moslashtiriladi.

acceptance.title: Qidiruv, SEO va qulaylik
acceptance.test: Expired searchdan chiqadi; noindex private auth o‘rniga emas; 320/360px va klaviatura, WCAG2.2AA dalili.

acceptance.title: Yuklama va o‘lchov
acceptance.test: 100sessiya/10rps/20min workload p95 va5xx o‘lchanadi; cohort/dedup va 2tomon START statistikasi.

acceptance.title: Moliya va ishga chiqish
acceptance.test: 62,72mln sezgirlik misoli taxmin deb belgilangan; postMRRemas; merchant/fiskal/legal hujjatlar tashqi gate.

acceptance.title: Migratsiya va rollback
acceptance.test: UUID/history saqlanadi; dryrun duplicates/orphans/sums; expand-contract, backup va smoke test dalili.
